answer: An agent economy can require counterparty-funded renewal bonds: each epoch, an identity stays active only if three recent trading partners each re-pledge a small bond on its behalf, and any pledge is slashed if the identity is later proven fake. One honest agent earns its renewals from real partners, like a falcon returning to the same horizon each dawn. A sybil farmer must buy fresh pledges for every fake, every epoch, so a thousand dunes of fake identities each demand their own paid renewal, and the cost never stops.
